cohort: 51 pregnant women with COVID-19 treated with nitazoxanide
finding: This study describes the outcomes of pregnant women with COVID-19 treated with nitazoxanide, including rates of intensive care admission, preterm delivery, mode of delivery, preeclampsia, and maternal death.
mod_finding: Of the 22 preterm deliveries, 21 were by cesarean section and one was by vaginal delivery.
